title: The predictions board, struck one by one

members.role: each prediction's SOURCE first: its press card (or record) on the word that quotes it - the board carries no claim the row has not sourced
then its chip in the rail beside it (one per prediction, on its word, the label naming the claim); on 'six months later' each is crossed in turn (cross_at, a word apart)

does: Other people's predictions land one per word - each its press card, then its chip on the rail - and on 'six months later' the chips are struck in turn: the board is read back as a record of what did not happen.

use_when.act: RETRACTS - a set of forecasts judged after the fact
use_when.shape: named things: 2-4 sourced predictions (who said what), then the date that judged them
use_when.use: other people's predictions lined up, then struck on 'six months later' (CHN 1:28-1:55: oil at $150-200, flights cancelled, recession)
use_when.dont: the predictions are unsourced (each names its press card or record); a prediction that has not been judged yet (a '?', not an X)

source: P71 T18 (was P69 T53; Bravos R13, CHN 1:28-1:55 - chips beside the broadcast that made each claim, struck on '6 months later'). Its members are proved by the goldens press-stack (the sourced cards) and chip-board (chips crossed on their words); the composed beat was read as a private test-bed strip for the next hook (scratchpad p71-t18 frames/strip r13), labelled as one; no approved cut carries it
